name: What is the typical warranty offered for exterior window sill replacement services?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical warranty offered for exterior window sill replacement services?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical warranty for exterior window sill replacement services often covers both the materials used and the labor for a specific period. The length of the warranty can vary by contractor and the type of material chosen. For example, some manufacturers offer long-term warranties on their composite sills, which we pass on to our customers, complementing our workmanship guarantee. We provide transparent details about our warranties with every project estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Warranties typically cover materials and labor; duration varies by contractor and material choice.
